seo.title: Max-Morrys Eyoum — Web design & digital training, from Dakar
seo.description: Who I am, my dated journey, what I do on the design track and on the learning track, and how Max-Morrys sits under MY ONOMA.

hero.lede: My name is Max-Morrys Eyoum. I grew up in Douala, studied in Abidjan, and it was in Dakar that digital became my trade — and then my way of passing it on.
hero.ledeShort: Douala, Abidjan, Dakar: it was in Dakar that digital became my trade.

steps.title: Where I come from.
steps.todayTitle: I train, I build, I pass it on
steps.todayBody: On the platform, in the Digitos Club, and with my studio.

skills.title: My everyday tools.
skills.lede: Digital marketing, brand design, the web and AI — learned in the field, taught ever since.

ventures.title: My own projects.
ventures.note: MY ONOMA projects, shown apart from client projects.

items.doven: A Christian social network: profiles, groups, churches, prayer.
items.steps: An African Christian magazine, in French and English.

beliefs.b1Body: Every lesson ends with a mission, never with theory.
beliefs.b2Title: We show what we can prove.
beliefs.b2Body: No made-up numbers, no bought reviews.
beliefs.b3Body: Tools designed for West Africa, not adapted after the fact.

m2014.title: The Start of the Adventure
m2014.desc: After my high-school diploma in Douala (Cameroon), I left to study in Abidjan. Formative years that opened my mind to opportunities in Africa.

m2017.title: Bachelor's in Economics — CERAP
m2017.desc: I earned my Bachelor's in Economics at CERAP Abidjan after 3 years rich in encounters and experiences.

m2018.title: Welcome to the Land of Teranga
m2018.desc: "Salam Aleykoum, nanga def"… I arrived in Senegal, this wonderful land of Teranga where I still live today.

m2020.title: Master's in Business Management & Development — BEM Dakar
m2020.desc: A pivot toward entrepreneurship. Math and I never really got along!

m2021.title: The Year Everything Changed
m2021.desc: Discovering digital marketing thanks to someone who matters to me. I "fell for it" and devoured every YouTube tutorial and Udemy course.

m2023Onoma.title: My Onoma — Freelance Digital Marketer
m2023Onoma.desc: First freelance contracts in web design, community management and SEO. Co-founding of My Onoma.

m2023Master.title: Master's in Digital Business — BEM Dakar
m2023Master.desc: A second Master's, this time in Digital Business, to consolidate growth + product expertise.

m2024Jan.title: Eyone Medical — Marketing & Growth Manager
m2024Jan.desc: I joined Eyone Medical, a pioneer in digitizing healthcare in Africa. Marketing, growth, content and partnerships — the role I still hold today.

m2024May.title: Académie Light — Trainer
m2024May.desc: Co-founding of Académie Light with a visionary friend. I became a digital marketing & community management trainer.

m2025Apr.title: Messages de Vie Senegal
m2025Apr.desc: I volunteered to lead the digital marketing of an organization running medical campaigns and free consultations for underserved populations.

m2025.title: Web & AI platforms in production
m2025.desc: Launching and scaling the Eyone Medical, Wergu Yaram and Topatoko platforms and end-to-end AI workflows for marketing and content.
